units.spine: Goods change hands here between households, and nothing is set out for buying and selling in quantity.
What has to be done here is done by whoever does it alongside their own work.
The stock is brought in close and the households with it, and the outer ground is abandoned ground.
Everything wrong with the hamlet has been wrong a long while, and none of it is pressing.
This is as far as Warmholz bends, and almost none of the bend is left.
The slide here is steady rather than sudden, and each season costs a little more than the one before it.
A year here ends near enough to level that the ending is watched.
More happens here than is ever spoken of, and what is spoken of is not the worst of it.
The hamlet covers what it costs on the terms it has, and the terms are not of its choosing.
Less stands between these houses and trouble than stands around most places this size.
Nobody here is under arms, and nothing is set up to change that.
Whatever lives past the last field is nobody's charge, and nothing is kept ready against it.
Plenty goes on that nobody answers for, and little of it is hidden from anybody passing through.
Nothing is spare, and that is the first thing a careful eye finds.
Magic is nobody's trade here, and nobody looks for it to be.
Food is not something anybody here thinks about.
The road runs through the place rather than to it.
Warmholz is a handful of roofs and the ground under them, and the ground is the reason for the roofs.
Households here are tied to one another by the grazing and the water, and by nothing stranger than that.
What is left undone is the sort of work a standing body would take over, and the place keeps no such body.
